name: Love x2 Kiss Yua to Mihiro Dokidoki Date
original_name: LOVE×2 KISS ゆあとみひろとドキドキデート
source:
Yua and Mihiro have won a trip to America in a lottery, but they feel uneasy about traveling abroad alone, so they invite you (the player) to join them.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080415192856/http://www.gbtp.jp:80/product/love2kiss.html]Offical Website (Machine translation)[/url]]
translation:
爱田由亚和朝美穗香在抽奖中赢得了一次美国旅行，但两人对独自出国感到不安，于是邀请你（玩家）同行。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080415192856/http://www.gbtp.jp:80/product/love2kiss.html]官方网站（英文来源标注为机器翻译）[/url]]
